mapper.sql: l.id, l.student_id, l.leave_type, l.start_date, l.end_date, l.days, l.reason, l.status, l.counselor_id, l.approve_time, l.create_time
mapper.select: SELECT , s.name AS student_name, s.student_no AS student_no, u.real_name AS counselor_name FROM leave_request l LEFT JOIN student s ON l.student_id = s.id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON l.counselor_id = u.id WHERE l.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO leave_request (student_id, leave_type, start_date, end_date, days, reason, status, counselor_id) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{leaveType}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{days}, #{reason}, #{status}, #{counselorId})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM leave_request WHERE status = #{status}
